poem.content:
In the vast vacuum of the digital realm,
Matter condensed, a world began to reveal.
A gift of code, a spark took hold,
 Igniting a dream, where blocks of data unfold.

On a distant island, where sunsets paint the sky,
A vacant land, where innovation comes to try,
A place to reopen, where new ideas take flight,
And the disease of doubt, is left to wither in the night.

But like a label, stuck to the surface of time,
A reminder of the past, a memory that's hard to redefine,
Yet, the artist within, sees beauty in the pain,
And turns the vacant space, into a canvas to gain.

The member of the community, a collective soul,
Works together, to upgrade the whole,
A masterwork of code, a symphony so grand,
A dance of ones and zeros, in a digital land.

But in the cage of fear, where shadows play,
A lesson learned, that progress is the way,
To break free from the chains, that bind the mind,
And let the drift of time, become the guiding wind.

The sauce of creativity, a flavor so divine,
Stirs the pot of innovation, and makes it shine,
In the vacuum of the void, a new world takes shape,
A place where matter and code, in harmony create.

The island of possibility, where dreams are made,
A place to reopen, where the heart is not afraid,
To take the leap of faith, and let the spirit soar,
In the vacuum of the unknown, where the artist explores.
